fail_closed_rule: If a required gate is failing or stale, default to no publication until the gate surfaces agree again.

gates.purpose: Confirm which bundle this is and whether the compact trust surfaces currently agree.
gates.default_when_not_satisfied: stop and repair bundle identity / trust surfaces before relying on them

gates.purpose: Answer what is publicly citable, what legacy links remain canonical, and what is merely frozen in-repo.
gates.default_when_not_satisfied: treat the public boundary as unresolved and publish nothing

gates.purpose: Trust queue counts, queue states, and the current decision lineage without crawling the directory tree by hand.
gates.default_when_not_satisfied: do not move papers between Hold / Candidate / Published-ready / Published

gates.purpose: Review or move a paper only with the actual rubric, review order, and written-decision discipline in hand.
gates.default_when_not_satisfied: record no move and leave the queue unchanged

gates.purpose: Execute an actual release only after a narrow explicit publish decision and preflight pass exist.
After any new public release, verify the published-facing boundary, citation heads, and archive trust surfaces again.
gates.default_when_not_satisfied: treat the post-publish audit as incomplete and avoid further release actions
